data.name: Aubida
data.gender_notes: Aubida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A garden filled with joy and happiness. The name Aubida carries the meaning “Joy of the garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Aubida usually hope their child will grow to embody joy of the garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the joy and happiness that comes from a deep connection to nature and the Creator
data.etymology: Aubida belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy of the garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aubida total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: عابده
in_arabic.long_meaning: عابده هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل عابد، يعني العبادة والخضوع لله تعالى، وهو من الأسماء المأخوذة من القرآن الكريم، ذكر في سورة الفرقان، وهو اسم شائع في الثقافة الإسلامية ويحمل معنىً عميقاً من التوجه للخالق والخضوع له

in_urdu.name: عابدہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عابدہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو عابد سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے الله کی عبادت اور اس کے لیے خضوع، یہ نام قرآن پاک سے لیا گیا ہے، اور مسلم ثقافت میں بہت مقبول ہے، یہ نام خالق کے لیے عقیدت اور محبت کا اظہار کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: आबिदा
in_hindi.long_meaning: आबिदा एक अरबी नाम है जो आबिद से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है भगवान की पूजा और उसके लिए समर्पण, यह नाम कुरान से लिया गया है, और मुस्लिम संस्कृति में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, यह नाम सर्जक के लिए प्रेम और सम्मान की अभिव्यक्ति करता है

in_pashto.name: عابده
in_pashto.long_meaning: عابده د عابد څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چې د الله عبادت او د هغه لپاره خپلواکي ته اشارې کوي، دا نوم د قرآن څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او په مسلم کلتور کې ډېر مشهور دی، دا نوم خالق لپاره د عقیدت او محبت ښودلو کوي

in_english.name: Aubida
in_english.meaning: Worshiper of Allah and obedient to Him
in_english.long_meaning: Aubida is a female given name derived from the Arabic word abid, meaning worship and obedience to Allah, it is one of the names taken from the Quran, and is widely used in Islamic culture, symbolizing devotion and love for the Creator

data.cultural_impact: The name Aubida holds a beautiful meaning in the Islamic culture, often representing a place of peace, tranquility, and happiness, akin to the gardens mentioned in the Quran. In Islamic architecture, gardens are often symbols of paradise, which is a place of eternal happiness and blessings. The name Aubida cultivates an image of delight, joy, and positivity for the one bearing this name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Aubida as a name can help its bearer foster a deep sense of joy and inner peace as it carries the meaning of a 'garden filled with happiness'. Gardens, in Islamic literature and teachings, are often associated with a place of spiritual growth, marking the importance of cultivating a peaceful and harmonious inner state, similar to the growth and blooming of beautiful flowers within a garden. May the name Aubida remind its bearer to invest time in their spiritual growth and reap the rewards of treasured joy, inner peace, and love.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Aubida: Devotion and love for the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). Symbolizing the deep commitment and unwavering loyalty to his teachings and legacy.
